transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I'm here because of some issues at work. I just... I keep making dumb mistakes on my sales reports. Like copying the wrong numbers off the team dashboard, or... missing a line in a procedure I'm supposed to check. Even when I thought I already went over it. So... yeah. That's mainly it.
Have you always struggled with this kind of focus and attention to detail, or is this something that has only started happening recently?

I guess... no, it's not new. I was like this as a kid, too. Um... my mom actually still brings up these old teacher notes from elementary school. They always said I rushed through my work, or... lost my homework. And, uh, that I talked out of turn... or couldn't just stay in my seat without them reminding me. So... yeah. It's not just a recent thing.
